sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Pros first: zest and segments are both useful. It can work as a snack, flavour boost, or cooking ingredient. Brings a clean fruit identity. It still contributes something valuable even when it is not elite. Ingredient simplicity is hard to argue with. Whole-fruit clarity is part of the category appeal.
